# Stiamond Digital

> AI, Software & Cloud Engineering — Solo Studio

Stiamond Digital is a solo studio led by Senankpon Josué Kpodekon, also known as Stiamond, based in Cotonou, Benin. One person covering development, design, marketing, AI automation, and IT project management — what most agencies split across 3-4 people. Clients work directly with the founder, not an account manager.

## Expertise (6 Pillars)

- Software Engineering: Custom software, web platforms, SaaS products, showcase sites and redesigns at scale (React, Vue, Next.js, Laravel, NestJS, Flutter)
- AI Engineering: LLM integration, RAG systems, AI agents, intelligent automation
- Cloud Infrastructure: Scalable architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, Cloudflare deployment
- Growth Systems: SEO, content strategy, marketing automation, data-driven growth
- Automation: n8n agents, workflow orchestration, process optimization (live in production)
- Creative & Content: Ad creatives, short-form video, Systeme.io funnels, Meta/Google/TikTok ads

## Proven Results

- 18+ e-commerce stores built (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- 7+ websites delivered, including showcase sites and redesigns at scale
- 69+ ad campaigns managed (Meta, Google, TikTok)
- AI agents running in production
- Google Marketing, Meta Marketing, and Data Analytics certifications (in progress / planned)
- 1-on-1 mentorship for full-stack dev and electrician-to-industrial-automation career changes
- IT project management and DSI (CIO) advisory

## Delivery Times

- Landing Page: 1-2 weeks
- E-commerce Store: 2-4 weeks
- Automation Agent: 2-4 weeks
- Custom Platform: 4-8 weeks

## Quality Standards

- Core Web Vitals: LCP under 2.5s, CLS under 0.1, INP under 200ms
- Clean code: TypeScript, proper architecture, code reviews
- SEO-ready: Structured data, meta tags, sitemap, semantic HTML

- 4 main packs: Website Showcase ($1,500), Systeme.io Funnel ($1,500), Complete Digital Presence ($4,200), Campaign Management ($1,500/mo)

  - Build & Launch: E-commerce Store, Idea to MVP, Cloud & SaaS Launch
  - Run & Scale: Business Automation, Growth Retainer, Lead Tech Advisory
